articles.title: Fast patrol vessel 'Amulya' commissioned into Indian Coast Guard
articles.summary: Indian Coast Guard ship Amulya, the third new-generation Adamya class fast patrol vessel, has been commissioned. This vessel significantly enhances the Coast Guard's capabilities for maritime security, surveillance, and search and rescue missions. Its deployment strengthens India's coastal defence and maritime law enforcement efforts, crucial for protecting national interests in the Exclusive Economic Zone.

articles.title: José Luis Cienfuegos, Renowned Director of Spain’s Valladolid, Seville and Gijón Festivals, to Receive Posthumous Bellas Artes Golden Order of Merit
articles.summary: José Luis Cienfuegos, a significant figure in Spanish cinema, has died from a stroke. He was an indefatigable force behind the modernization and international vision of three major Spanish film festivals. Cienfuegos championed new talent and enhanced their industry and popular impact, leaving a lasting legacy on the global film community by elevating these cultural events.
